map.输入转大写后按空白切分为单词，每个单词再逐字符查莫尔斯码表：命中则取对应编码并按: The input is uppercased and split into words on whitespace; each word is then looked up character by character in the Morse table: hits take the corresponding code wrapped according to the selected style, while spaces and unknown characters are skipped; codes within a word are joined with a single space, and words are joined by either a slash padded with spaces or two spaces depending on the toggle. The result is concatenated into the full Morse output.
map.按空白切词、逐字符查 ITU 码表；表外字符跳过。解码按「/」或 2 个以上空格: Split words on whitespace and look up each character in the ITU table; characters outside the table are skipped. Decoding splits words on "/" or two or more spaces and codes on whitespace, marking misses as "?". Three symbol styles (. - / · — / DIT DAH) and a CSV detail export are supported; there is no timing inference, audio or image input, and no noise tolerance. Prosigns are decode-only.

map.增强版增加三种符号样式、「用 / 分隔单词」开关、Prosigns 解码与 CS: The enhanced version adds three symbol styles, a "Use / to separate words" toggle, prosign decoding and a CSV detail export. Conversion still works by table lookup segment by segment; it does not infer timing or correct transcribed errors.
map.为什么解出的字母是「?」？: Why does a decoded letter come out as "?"?
map.解码按「/」或 2 个以上空格切词、按空白切码，每个码必须整段命中码表；缺少分隔: Decoding splits words on "/" or two or more spaces and codes on whitespace, and every code must match the table as a whole; missing separators or mixed dot/dash glyphs produce "?".
